lidc-idri-0525-native.title: Inspect complete source CT and separate original nodule annotations
lidc-idri-0525-native.caption: One released LIDC-IDRI source CT study, LIDC-IDRI-0525: all 429 original CT sections, all 33 original XML marks from four reading sessions, and eight separate released SEG and SR annotation pairs. Inspect exact stored values and source-calibrated HU, original contours, and complete sampling-cell boundaries. Reader assessments and contour metrics are source annotations, not verified histology or Fleischner mean caliper measurements. Reconstructed slice thickness differs from reconstruction centre spacing; acquired collimation is unverified. Source dates do not establish longitudinal growth. Normal lobe, segment, airway and vascular coverage and clinical tissue boundaries remain unverified.
lidc-idri-0525-native.attribution: Armato et al., LIDC-IDRI, TCIA, DOI 10.7937/K9/TCIA.2015.LO9QL9SX; Fedorov et al., standardized LIDC annotations, TCIA, DOI 10.7937/TCIA.2018.h7umfurq. CC BY 3.0. Original DICOM, XML, source license and released annotation archives unchanged; lossless complete-array transport and literal sampling-cell boundary display added. Retain dataset citations, license link and this modification description in downstream reuse.
